title: LOGOS ASF — TR-05 Model Lineage Record
description: Constitutional data contract for model lineage DAG records. Each record ties a model artifact back through DEP.KEYSTONE/GovSec ingress, source registry, clearance ledger, synthetic provenance, dataset manifests, dry-run envelopes, and future promotion decisions.

lineage_record_id.description: Deterministic identifier for this lineage record. Format: LR-<sha256[:16]>.

artifact_id.description: Reference to the model_artifact_id this lineage record describes.

artifact_type.description: Artifact type, matching the registry entry.

parent_artifacts.description: Upstream artifact IDs this artifact was derived from.

dep_keystone_ingress_refs.description: DEP.KEYSTONE ingress record IDs (DKI-*) that cleared the source for this artifact.

source_registry_refs.description: Source registry IDs (L<N>-NNN) for all contributing sources.

clearance_ledger_refs.description: Clearance ledger entry IDs (LE-*) for all source clearances.

synthetic_manifest_refs.description: References to synthetic_manifest.json files if synthetic data contributed.

synthetic_review_bridge_refs.description: References to synthetic review bridge manifests.

dataset_manifest_refs.description: References to TR-03 dataset manifest IDs.

dry_run_envelope_refs.description: References to TR-04B dry-run envelope IDs (DR-*).

training_job_contract_refs.description: References to signed training job contracts. Empty until a contract is signed.

evaluation_refs.description: References to TR-06 evaluation records. Empty until TR-06 is implemented.

promotion_decision_refs.description: References to operator promotion decision records.

lineage_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the key provenance fields of this record. Enables tamper detection.

previous_lineage_hash.description: lineage_hash of the previous lineage record in the chain. Genesis records use 64 zero hex chars.

governance_flags.description: Governance flags inherited from the registry entry.

x-invariants.lineage_hash_covers_provenance: lineage_hash is computed from artifact_id, artifact_type, and all *_refs arrays. Changing any ref changes the hash.
x-invariants.genesis_previous_hash: First lineage record for any artifact uses previous_lineage_hash = 64 zero hex chars.
x-invariants.governance_flags_const: All governance_flags are const values. They cannot be overridden.
x-invariants.no_tr06: evaluation_refs is empty until TR-06 is implemented.
x-invariants.no_real_training: This lineage record describes metadata only. No model weights exist.
